Description: This consensus file catalogues all RNA modification sites identified using the Illumina platform. It aggregates diverse modification types from multiple methods, retaining high-confidence sites supported by at least two replicates per method.

This file catalogues modifications identified via oligonucleotide mass spectrometry across all submitted samples. Entries meet the following minimum quality thresholds: a false discovery rate (FDR) ≤ 5% for the detected oligonucleotide, a modification level ≥ 10%, and concordant detection across all samples covering the respective position.

This file includes predicted RNA modifications using ONT dorado modification-aware basecalling models. RNA modified sites were grouped into two tiers: i) tier 1 Reflects sites which show a significant modification level change between IVT and native RNA; ii) tier 2 reflects sites which did not have IVT with sufficient coverage, but showed a score >0.9 derived from the equally weighted sum of min max normalized log2(coverage), modification level and model confidence ranks.
